payload.notes: First independent reproduction of the solo circuit vk.key (batch_size 1). Disposable 2c/8GB x86 host (Hetzner), Python 3.13.15, ezkl 23.0.5, network-isolated compute (unshare -n). Reproduced with our own driver and cross-checked against the repo's verify.py --circuit solo; both plus a manual re-hash yield keccak256 0x13cff0426abe00c941934bdd6bb7757f2e703fb9f6862bf08a783eeca08b4ff2 == the solo vkHashFile registered on Base Sepolia (84532). Measured wall 14.5s, peak RSS 957MB.

scheme: EIP-191 personal_sign over the RFC8785/JCS canonicalization of the payload sub-object ONLY (json.dumps sort_keys, separators (',',':')); signing input = keccak256("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n" + str(jcs_len) + jcs_bytes), decimal-ASCII length; recover == signed_by (0x57fF0F084Cba33e6761503f90eEF0Da9F159350c). Authority: signers[signed_by] scope includes reproduction-attestations at https://x402.nsgoods.org/proof/index.json
